validity.recommendation: Change Owner1 from 'National Iranian Oil Co' (NIOC) to National Iranian Gas Company (NIGC); note builder = Iran Gas Engineering and Development Company (IGEDC), an NIGC subsidiary.
validity.researcher_notes: EXISTENCE: confirmed real. The line was inaugurated in a ceremony at Zabol in late Aug 2022 connecting Zabol to the national gas grid; corroborated by two independent origins — PressTV (state broadcaster, 2022-08-28) and Financial Tribune (2022-05-08). Both name Zahedan–Zabol explicitly and describe it as an extension of Iran Gas Trunkline-7 (IGAT-7) from Asalouyeh. CLASSIFICATION: correctly a gas transmission trunk (IGAT-7 extension carrying South Pars gas into Sistan-Baluchestan to towns/power/cement plants), not gathering/process/oil. DUPLICATE: not a duplicate — distinct from GulfPub 'Iranshahr - Zahedan Gas Pipeline' (Iranshahr→Zahedan, 174km, the upstream leg) and from Iranshahr–Chabahar; Zahedan→Zabol is the northeast continuation. No matching ProjectID in the Iran gas roster. ATTRIBUTION ERROR: GEM Owner = 'National Iranian Oil Co' (NIOC). Both independent sources state the pipeline was laid by Iran Gas Engineering and Development Company (IGEDC), a subsidiary of NIGC — a domestic gas transmission line, so owner should be NIGC, not NIOC. FuelSource='Zahedan' is also questionable (physical gas source is South Pars via IGAT-7 from Asalouyeh; Zahedan is the tie-in/start point, not the fuel source).

routes.corridor_desc: Runs north-northeast from Zahedan up through the Sistan plain toward Zabol near the Afghan border, broadly following the Zahedan–Zabol highway (Road 84) corridor. Straight-line Zahedan–Zabol is ~175 km; the sourced pipeline length (219–250 km) is consistent with a road-following alignment. Corridor is bounded by the two named cities and the single main highway between them — tight in the north-south sense but the exact alignment (and whether it hugs the road or the Hamun basin edge) is not traced by any source.
routes.researcher_notes: Endpoints established from two independent sources naming Zahedan and Zabol. Coordinates are the standard populated-place centroids for Zahedan (~29.50N,60.86E) and Zabol (~31.03N,61.50E); Zahak waypoint (~30.89N,61.68E) is a real town on the corridor but its inclusion on the exact route is inferred, not sourced. No coordinates fabricated — no source publishes a route trace, so alignment is described in prose only. Corridor supports at most medium accuracy.

summary: P6028 Zahedan–Zabol is a real, correctly-classified IGAT-7 gas transmission extension (Aug 2022); attribution wrong (Owner NIOC → should be NIGC/IGEDC) and length source-conflicted (250 km FT vs 219 km PressTV).
